title: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Steve?
description:
Six real pictures connect Adolf Hitler to Minecraft's Steve, through Chamberlain, Churchill, the Queen, Angelina Jolie and Jack Black.

Adolf Hitler → Neville Chamberlain → Winston Churchill → Elizabeth II → Angelina Jolie → Jack Black → Steve

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
